digest.component_or_area: terraform-drift GitHub workflow and Gerrit CI integration
propositions: terraform-drift.yml triggers only on pull_request, push to main, schedule, and manual dispatch — never on Gerrit changes — so Gerrit submissions bypass the drift check until after they land
a terraform change can receive Verified +1 and be submitted without the workflow ever confirming the HCL resources are applied, leaving main red post-merge
the post-merge drift check cannot distinguish between newly-added (legitimately un-applied) terraform and previously-committed (incorrectly never-applied) resources
terraform apply is manual and undocumented as a landing prerequisite, so reviewers cannot surface or enforce application as a gate condition
the 34cd change added aws_cloudwatch_metric_alarm to HCL, passed all gates, landed to main, then failed the post-merge drift check because the alarm was never applied to CloudWatch
